Overall was very good & sumptuous.
Worth the money, must try.

featured_reviews.name: Shillpa Kataria Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I spotted my favorite café, Third Wave Coffee, at R-City Mall, I was so excited! I absolutely love all their preparations – from the cappuccino to their unique Vietnamese Shakeratoo(my absolute favorite!), and of course their extraordinary matcha. I’ve even tried the mango matcha and strawberry matcha, which are both totally yum.
At this outlet, I ordered my go-to cappuccino with a chocolate croissant – the perfect combination to wake me up and power through the day – while my daughter enjoyed a refreshing matcha.
The ambience here is lovely, with great music, cozy seating, and some people working remotely on their laptops, which gave the place a vibrant yet relaxed vibe. Honestly, it didn’t even feel like we were in Mumbai – it had such a refreshing, different atmosphere.
So glad Third Wave Coffee has an outlet here – makes R-City Mall visits even better! Highly recommend.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Shillpa,

Thank you for sharing your valuable feedback. We are happy to see that you liked our food and ambiance. We'll ensure that your feed back reaches to our concern team. We look forward to serving you again soon.

featured_reviews.review_text: Chacha Juice Wala, located in Ghatkopar MG road just on the left side once taken a right from LBS Marg while going towards Sarvodaya Hospital. Besides MI mobile gallery on the left hand side. It brought the best experience ever with the Masala milk shake that I had. Photos I've posted above. Sooooo refreshing n filling wit cashews n anjeer n badam n a taste of mango, chikoo n mixed fruit. it really delighted the mood n made me completely full with my tummy. Good that I didn't have a heavy dinner. I would seriously blast with this regular glass of milkshake. spoken to the people working, said that it's been at this location since May 1971 & is still going. Just incase if u do not find the cart there. Look in the surrounding place's. having said that there is a Cops round up n they ask to close down their business because it makes a lot of crowd on the road & creates difficulty to the passing vehicles. As far as I've noticed it is very in their corner & doesn't harm the traffic o anythng because their timings are from 10pm to 1:00am. 1:30am at the max which is quite adjustable with the passing traffic. Everyone should visit this Chacha juice wala atleast once, n it will get you back once again just because of their quality, taste n variety.

featured_reviews.name: Pandurang Pable
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the snack center and tried their pizza, sandwich, strawberry juice, and chocolate sandwich.

The pizza was flavorful with a perfect crust, and the sandwiches were fresh and delicious.

The strawberry juice was refreshing and made with fresh fruit.

However, the chocolate sandwich was a standout - it was indulgent and satisfying, a perfect treat for chocolate lovers.

Overall, the food quality was excellent, and the variety offered was impressive. I highly recommend trying these items when visiting the snack center!

My experience was delightful not only because of the delicious food but also due to the exceptional service. The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and accommodating. They were knowledgeable about the menu and provided recommendations that perfectly matched my preferences.

Moreover, the owner's presence was evident in the attention to detail and the high standards maintained throughout. It's clear that the owner takes pride in the snack center, as reflected in the quality of both the food and service. Their dedication to ensuring a pleasant experience for customers is commendable.

In summary, the snack center not only offers delectable food items such as pizza, sandwiches, strawberry juice, and the exquisite chocolate sandwich but also provides top-notch service and a welcoming environment.

I left feeling satisfied and impressed with both the culinary offerings and the excellent customer care.

It's definitely a place I'll be returning to and recommending to friends and family.
